dimensions.assessment: Affects individuals, entities, or organizations investigated or prosecuted for fraud in connection with the Shuttered Venue Operators Grant and Restaurant Revitalization Fund.
Extends the potential legal liability window for certain fraud offenses to 10 years, which is life-changing for those facing criminal or civil enforcement actions.
dimensions.evidence: any criminal prosecution or civil enforcement action... shall be filed not later than 10 years after the date of the violation

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state specific federal spending or revenue changes.
Amends existing statutes of limitations for two specific pandemic relief programs.
dimensions.evidence: Section 324 of division N of the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2021... is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanently amends the statute of limitations terms for the specified grant programs.

importance_detail.rationale: This bill extends the statute of limitations to 10 years for fraud-related criminal and civil offenses involving specific COVID-19 relief programs, affecting legal accountability and potential prosecutions without creating new spending programs.
